title: Saudi skyscraper hit again, coalition slams 'terrorist attack'
summary: The Saudi capital's tallest skyscraper was struck for a second time in days on Tuesday injuring 11 people, as the coalition fighting Yemen's Houthis denounced a "terrorist attack".
